issues: Row 25 (СанПиН 2.2.4.3359-16 п.п.9.2,9.3): the printed indicator lists three UV sub-bands (УФ-А/В/С) under a single measurement range (1-40000) мВт/м2; kept as one row since only one range value is printed for the combined indicator, not per sub-band. Row 27 'Напряжённость электростатического поля' is printed with unit 'кВт/м' (kilowatt/meter) in the source document, which is physically unusual for an electric-field-strength quantity (typically кВ/м) but is transcribed exactly as printed per the no-invention rule. No ТР ТС / раздел section headings appear anywhere in this document, so tr_section is null on every row.
